description: Na₂CdSnS₄ is Stannite-like structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal I̅4 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four equivalent S atoms to form NaS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaS₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent CdS₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four equivalent SnS₄ tetrahedra. All Na-S bond lengths are 2.76 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four equivalent S atoms to form NaS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaS₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent CdS₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four equivalent SnS₄ tetrahedra. All Na-S bond lengths are 2.84 Å. Cd is bonded to four equivalent S atoms to form CdS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent SnS₄ tetrahedra and corners with eight NaS₄ tetrahedra. All Cd-S bond lengths are 2.57 Å. Sn is bonded to four equivalent S atoms to form SnS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent CdS₄ tetrahedra and corners with eight NaS₄ tetrahedra. All Sn-S bond lengths are 2.43 Å. S is bonded to two Na, one Cd, and one Sn atom to form corner-sharing SNa₂CdSn tetrahedra.
